title: Bay Life Getaways
blurb: Bay Life Getaways offers a variety of tours and rentals in Traverse City such as Platte River tubing, Sleeping Bear Dunes tours, wine tours, kayak and paddle board rentals, and rickshaw tours. Each getaway includes a trip-mate passionate about the area's special features to ensure a great vacation. They also provide designated driver services and custom private getaways.
